newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide rebels could win key vote - FT.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide rebels could win key vote - FT.

text.p: Rebel members of the Nationwide building society could win a key vote in the battle to convert the society into a bank, the Financial Times said on Friday.
It said there had been an unexpectedly big vote for the five rebels who are seeking election to the board on a pro-conversion ticket.
The rebels say Nationwide members would receive a windfall of at least 1,000 pounds each if conversion went ahead.

Nationwide Chief Executive Brian Davis, quoted by the paper, said: "I would be very surprised if they (the rebels) do not get a lot of votes. Many people are not aware of the issues and they are going to be attracted by 1,000 pounds."
"We have to be realistic and the vote is phenomenal and it is very representative. We have got to listen to what has been said," he added.
